summary: iter126 Dispatch Portal portal-auth + cross-portal /api/operations/* read access verified end-to-end. All 11 new iter126 pytests pass; regression of iter122 (integrations, 23 tests), iter123 (mappings wizard, 7 tests), iter124 (operations, 15 tests) — 56/56 passed. Frontend E2E flow validated: dispatch login → must_change_password redirect → change-password → /dispatch-portal hub (testid present) → all 5 tabs render with live data. RequireDispatch guard redirects unauthenticated users to /dispatch-portal/login. Cross-portal observations: dispatch token reads & writes /api/operations/*; safety token reads only and is correctly rejected (401/403) on writes; admin token unchanged.

ui_bugs.issue: PRD says hub should expose a 'Switch Portal' button alongside 'Sign out'. Only 'Sign out' is rendered. The PortalSwitcher map was updated (per files_of_reference) but the button is not actually mounted in DispatchHub.jsx header.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Add a 'Switch Portal' button to DispatchHub header — PortalSwitcher map already includes dispatch, just need to mount the switcher control next to 'Sign out'.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: dispatch_users.py mirrors safety_users.py cleanly; bcrypt-bound HMAC token rotation pattern preserved (resetting password invalidates old tokens). Good.
Backend: make_require_any_portal_token in _deps.py correctly accepts X-Dispatch-Token; write endpoints use a dedicated admin-or-dispatch helper — split-gate works exactly as documented.

Frontend: api.js now fans X-Dispatch-Token + X-Safety-Token + X-HR-Token + X-PM-Token + X-Shop-Token + X-Admin-Token on every request. This is fine because each backend gate is header-specific (verified), but be aware that any FUTURE route that does generic 'first non-empty header wins' would break scope isolation. Recommend an explicit comment in api.js warning against that pattern.
Frontend: AdminDispatch.jsx tab components are now exported and reused in DispatchHub.jsx — good DRY win.
test_credentials.md: dispatch section accurately documents the temp-password-only design.
test_credentials: Admin: POST /api/admin/login {password: MASCI1982!}. Dispatch: dispatch@mascigc.com — password rotated to 'DispatchTest2026!' during this test run (was reset to a temp via admin endpoint, then changed via /api/dispatch/change-password). Safety: safety@mascigc.com / Safety123!
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Two ephemeral pytest dispatch users were created and deleted within their own tests. One smoke event with event_type='dispatch_smoke' was inserted by the WRITE-gate test (negligible).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter126 is complete. dispatch@mascigc.com password is now 'DispatchTest2026!' (must_change_password=false). If you need to re-test the must-change flow, hit POST /api/admin/dispatch-users/{id}/reset-password with the admin token first — that flips must_change_password back to true and returns a fresh temp_password. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter126_dispatch_auth.py. The api.js axios interceptor sends ALL portal tokens on every request — this is intentional but every new portal-scoped route MUST validate its specific header, NOT 'any portal token wins'.
rca of the issue: Initial Playwright run timed out on networkidle (long-polling/keepalives kept connections open). Fixed by switching to specific selectors + page.expect_response(...) for the actual /api/dispatch/login + /api/dispatch/change-password calls. Underlying app functionality was never broken — only the wait strategy.
